title: Sandi R NDE 6505
content: It was a rainy afternoon when we were driving home from my grandmother's after a visit. I was in the back seat with my two younger sisters. Two young men were racing their cars when one driver lost control and hit our car head-on. I remember hearing my mother yelling my father's name and then I rose up out of the car. I remember going right through the car's roof and being held in clouds of amazing colors. The colors were brilliant and very comforting. I could ‘see’ the colors and ‘feel’ them simultaneously. It was as if I was held in someone's arms, like a baby is held. I knew God was there with someone else too. I was not sure who the other ‘being’ was, I have always assumed it was Jesus who was holding me. They were not in bodily form; they were part of the cloud-like colors. I felt absolutely no fear, only peace and comfort. Suddenly, I was in the back seat of the car again. I could tell that some time had elapsed, as there were police and emergency medical technician personnel helping my mother with several other people around. The emergency medical technician personnel got us out of the car and brought us to the hospital. I was the last of my family members examined because I was the calmest. I had a broken collarbone and was feeling little pain. I have never been the same since this experience. I am now without fear or doubts about death.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Rose up out of the car and went right through the car's roof.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Felt held like a baby is held; no fear, only peace and comfort.

arrival.religious_figure_detail: Experiencer assumed the other being may have been Jesus, but was not sure.
arrival.other_being_detail: Another being was present with God; not sure who.

environment.environment_other_detail: Held in clouds of amazing, brilliant, comforting colors; could 'see' and 'feel' the colors simultaneously; beings were part of the cloud-like colors.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Head-on car collision caused by a racing driver losing control.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Experienced being held in brilliant, comforting cloud-like colors; sensed God and another being; then suddenly back in the car with time elapsed.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (rising out through roof) followed by colored cloud realm with sensed beings; then sudden return to the car without tunnel, boundary, or life review.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Perceived 'clouds of amazing colors' that could be both seen and felt simultaneously; beings were not in bodily form but part of the cloud-like colors; felt held like a baby.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I remember going right through the car's roof and being held in clouds of amazing colors.”
